2607.07235.title: ORCAID: Oblique Rule-Based Continuous-Action Interpretation for Deep RL Policies
2607.07235.paper_summary: Explainability remains a key issue in reinforcement learning (RL). Distilling an interpretable policy from an agent trained in a complex environment is particularly challenging when the action space is continuous. We introduce ORCAID, a novel method for extracting interpretable rule-based policies from RL agents operating in mixed continuous-discrete environments with continuous action spaces. Our main contribution is an efficient oblique decision tree training algorithm that partitions the state space by hyperplanes and fits local linear models. The key idea lies in a three-stage split search: efficient random initialization, local refinement, and backward elimination. Finally, adjacent leaves are merged to yield a concise set of interpretable rules describing a given deep RL policy. We evaluate ORCAID across multiple RL environments, demonstrating that the extracted rule-based policies maintain strong performance with a low number of parameters and can even be used to improve the performance of the original deep RL policy.
2607.07235.paper_summary_zh: 可解釋性仍然是強化學習（RL）中的一個關鍵問題。從在複雜環境中訓練的代理中提煉出可解釋的政策，尤其在行動空間為連續時，特別具有挑戰性。我們介紹了 ORCAID，一種從在混合連續-離散環境中運作的 RL 代理中提取可解釋的基於規則的政策的新方法，該環境具備連續行動空間。我們的主要貢獻是一種高效的斜決策樹訓練算法，該算法通過超平面劃分狀態空間並擬合局部線性模型。關鍵思想在於三階段的拆分搜索：高效的隨機初始化、局部優化和向後消除。最後，相鄰的葉子被合併，以產生一組簡潔的可解釋規則，描述給定的深度 RL 政策。我們在多個 RL 環境中評估了 ORCAID，證明提取的基於規則的政策在參數數量較少的情況下仍能保持強大的性能，甚至可以用來改善原始深度 RL 政策的性能。
